scope: Declared finite prescription; published regions/phases unverified.

solver.solver: Clarabel current SDP over saved M50 feasible hull
solver.selection: Same-model columns; zero objective maximizes only a numerical chiral interior margin; final constraints unchanged

outer.scope: Joint finite saved float64 H/K/k/FESR operator; all native current Grams, FF caps and original amplitude constraints; no continuum certificate

current_model.scattering_policy: Retain every supplied scattering row; the current principal blocks imply the native S0/P1 disks
current_model.form_factor_rule: F=1+q(s)@ImF; q uses all sine-cardinal modes and q(0)=0; native ReF=1+K@ImF
current_model.spectrum_rule: Independent physical current spectral values at the M native nodes; no off-node interpolation imposed

uv.units: divide physical GeV quantities by m_pi to the stated power

current_model.scope: D1 affine operators and D2 connection data only; no joint feasible solution or gauge support claimed
current_model.arithmetic: Arb kernel and kinematic factors rounded to float64; supplied amplitude rows reused unchanged
